Maharashtra TET Paper Leak Case: Investigation Underway, Leaders React

The Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) has been cancelled following a suspected question paper leak. An investigation is underway, with a Bihar-based conman suspected to be the mastermind. Opposition leaders have criticized the ruling BJP over the incident.
